title: Grateful Dead Live at Giants Stadium on 1989-07-09
lineage: Cassette Master (Nakamichi CR-7A) > Tascam DA-3000 (DSF 1-bit/5.6 MHz) >KORG AudioGate 4 > Adobe Audition CC 2015 > Samplitude Pro X3 Suite > FLAC/24

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard source with a punchy bass and standout performances of Queen Jane Approximately and Bird Song.
ai_review.review: The recording is praised as the best‑sounding CM soundboard source, featuring a noticeably fuller bass that adds clarity to the mix. The first set shines with a nicely rendered Queen Jane Approximately and an energetic Bird Song, making it a solid show despite limited commentary on other portions.

ai_rating.rationale: A single 4‑star review highlights both strong soundboard quality and an engaging first set, indicating a good overall experience.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Bass is more present than in other CM soundboard releases; the mix is clear and well‑balanced.

show_quality.setlist_flow: First set praised for a strong Queen Jane Approximately and an energetic Bird Song, suggesting solid pacing and momentum early in the concert.

band_member_comments.Phil: Bass noted as more present than in other sources.
